title: Deployment, Verification, and Operations
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Deployment, Verification, and Operations and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 17: Deployment, Verification, and Operations; it lists all 14 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 17 roadmap: Understanding Blockchain Networks and Chain IDs; Local, Development, Test, and Production Environments; Preparing a Contract for Deployment; Deployment Scripts and Automation; Environment Variables and Secrets Management; Deploying to a Local EVM Network; Deploying to a Test Network; Deploying to a Production Network; Verifying Source Code on Block Explorers; Managing Contract Addresses and Deployment Artifacts; Post-Deployment Validation; Monitoring Contract Events and Transactions; Incident Response and Emergency Procedures; Maintaining and Documenting Deployed Contracts. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.
